title: Justify
description: A lyric set as a force-justified block in soft black Arial on white. Drag the right edge and the words flow like one ribbon around the margin; the lyrics, softness and sound sit underneath as one more justified line of the same Arial, the chosen one marked with a pale-blue text selection, and dragging the word soft blurs the block.
intent: Force-justification as a live material with reflow that is physically continuous: the measure is a roller the text winds around, so every word keeps one body and one path, interruptible mid-drag.
sources: herb reference board: 0fc59ca9 (I'm a star justified block) and ee6eda60 (the sun'll come out, blurred justified block)
